title: Solution MC-ICP-MS Analysis Detail
description: Dataset-level analysis-instance detail for solution MC-ICP-MS, reusing CDIF/schema.org slots on the schema:Dataset root.

schema:description.description: Brief description of sample provenance, form, or preparation state relevant to this analysis.

anyOf.title: Doubly-Charged Species Monitor
anyOf.description: The mass ratio monitored to estimate doubly-charged ion (M²⁺) formation during instrument tuning. The monitor species and the mass positions monitored should be stated explicitly. Analogous to Oxide Production Method and Threshold for oxide monitoring.

anyOf.title: Doubly-Charged Species Production
anyOf.description: Measured percentage of doubly-charged ion production for the monitored species at the time of instrument tuning. The acceptable threshold is typically <1% or <3%. Record both the threshold and the measured value.

contains.title: Doubly-Charged Species Monitor
contains.description: The mass ratio monitored to estimate doubly-charged ion (M²⁺) formation during instrument tuning. The monitor species and the mass positions monitored should be stated explicitly. Analogous to Oxide Production Method and Threshold for oxide monitoring.

contains.title: Doubly-Charged Species Production
contains.description: Measured percentage of doubly-charged ion production for the monitored species at the time of instrument tuning. The acceptable threshold is typically <1% or <3%. Record both the threshold and the measured value.

anyOf.title: Error Correlation Between Reported Quantities
anyOf.description: The correlation coefficient between pairs of reported quantities whose uncertainties are not independent, together with the pair it applies to and how it was obtained.

contains.title: Error Correlation Between Reported Quantities
contains.description: The correlation coefficient between pairs of reported quantities whose uncertainties are not independent, together with the pair it applies to and how it was obtained.

ada:proceduralBlankLevel.description: The measured level of the analytical blank in the session, and — where the reported quantity is a ratio — its composition, since a blank subtracted from a ratio biases the result unless its own composition is known. Companion to the blank correction method.

ada:deltaOrEpsilonValueReferenceStandard.description: International or community-accepted isotopic reference standard used as the zero-delta anchor for expressing isotopic compositions in delta (δ, per mil) or epsilon (ε, per ten thousand) notation: δⁱX = [(ⁱX/ʲX)sample / (ⁱX/ʲX)reference − 1] × 1000‰. The reporting reference is a per-study or per-publication decision. Specify the standard name, lot or batch number where applicable, and the certified or consensus isotope ratio used for normalization.

anyOf.title: Dataset variable
anyOf.description: A measured variable of this dataset that is not one of the procedure's declared reported properties. schema:variableMeasured carries the dataset's actual variables; the reported-property branches above are permitted members of it, not the whole of it.

anyOf.title: Isotope Ratio Reported
anyOf.description: Specific isotope ratio pair(s) reported as primary data output. The denominator isotope is typically the reference mass used in the delta notation (e.g., 54Fe for Fe isotopes, 235U for U isotopes). Report all ratio pairs routinely calculated and reported.

contains.title: Isotope Ratio Reported
contains.description: Specific isotope ratio pair(s) reported as primary data output. The denominator isotope is typically the reference mass used in the delta notation (e.g., 54Fe for Fe isotopes, 235U for U isotopes). Report all ratio pairs routinely calculated and reported.
